title: Monad Airdrop Details
content: The Monad airdrop claim portal is now live, with users required to connect their wallets and accounts by November 3, 2025, at 13:00 UTC to avoid permanent locking of their claim profiles. After this deadline, the official allocation amounts will be revealed. An optional early reveal event is scheduled for October 28, 2025, allowing users to view their airdrop amounts prior to the deadline. The portal launch was announced on October 14, 2025, at 21:02 on Medium.com.

title: Monad Airdrop Launch Spurs Excitement, But Some Doubts Remain
content: The Monad Foundation has officially launched the MON airdrop, allowing 5,500 Monad community members and nearly 225,000 participants from the broader crypto ecosystem to claim tokens via the verified portal at claim.monad.xyz. The claim window remains open until November 3, 2025. Eligibility is based on participation in initiatives like the Monad Community Recognizer and Monad Cards, with qualified recipients falling into five categories: Monad Community, On-chain Users, Crypto Community, Crypto Contributors, and Monad Builders—those meeting multiple criteria may claim combined allocations. Authentication is handled via Privy, supporting EVM and Solana wallets, Twitter, Discord, and email, with warnings against imposter sites and no advantage to early claiming. Anti-sybil measures include Trusta AI for bot detection and manual verification. Despite the launch, market skepticism persists: Polymarket data shows only 5% expect distribution by October 31, while 93% anticipate a late-November drop and 98% a December 31 release. Some traders express frustration over testnet users being excluded. The airdrop targets experienced Web3 users, including DeFi traders, NFT collectors, and contributors like ZachXBT and members of Protocol Guild, though Monad and Category Labs employees are ineligible. Analysts note this aligns with a broader trend of community-driven token launches, with Dragonfly’s State of Airdrops Report 2025 indicating that restrictive U.S. policies excluded millions of American users from airdrops between 2020 and 2024, resulting in an estimated $1.8 billion to $2.6 billion in lost revenue and prompting many projects to relocate offshore for regulatory clarity. The success of the MON airdrop will significantly influence user confidence ahead of Monad’s public mainnet launch.

title: Monad Airdrop Portal’ı Açıyor: Şüpheler Devam Ediyor
content: Monad announced that its Airdrop Claims Portal will launch in the coming week, sparking significant excitement within the community. However, skepticism remains regarding whether the airdrop is truly imminent. While the announcement led to a slight increase in Polymarket traders' expectations for an October airdrop, most users still believe the event will occur in November or later. Keone Hon, Monad’s co-founder, previously claimed the network’s native gas token would have a total initial supply of 100 billion, potentially bringing substantial liquidity. Recently, Monad shared a cryptic update showing an almost completed progress bar, followed by a direct statement that the Claims Portal would open in less than a week. The announcement generated massive attention, with the post viewed over one million times in under two hours. Despite this, community skepticism persists: the portal is seen as a significant step, but not definitive proof of a real airdrop. Polymarket data shows fewer than 40% of traders believe the airdrop will happen this month, with the majority anticipating November. Critics also note that Monad’s progress indicators may be overly optimistic, as the company has repeatedly claimed near-completion of its devnet over the past year, yet the testnet only launched in February 2025, with unclear progress since. Although uncertainty remains, community enthusiasm is high, and a confirmed airdrop would likely be a major event—pending further verification.

title: Monad Airdrop: 230,000 Crypto Users Can Now Claim MON Tokens
content: The Monad Foundation has launched the official MON airdrop claim portal, enabling over 230,000 recipients to claim MON tokens ahead of the Monad Public Mainnet launch. The airdrop includes 5,500 core community members and approximately 225,000 participants from the broader crypto ecosystem. Claiming is available through the verified platform at @monad, using Privy for authentication via EVM or Solana wallets, with optional social account linking (Twitter, Discord, Telegram, Farcaster, email). The claim period runs until November 3, 2025, with no incentive to claim early. Eligibility spans five categories: Monad Community (long-term ecosystem shapers), Onchain Users (active in EVM/Solana, including high-volume DEX traders, DeFi contributors, and NFT holders like CryptoPunks and Pudgy Penguins), Crypto Community (Web3 users from Legion, Backpack, Farcaster, LobsterDAO), Crypto Contributors and Crypto Curious (security researchers, educators, students from SEAL 911, RareSkills, SheFi), and Monad Builders (hackathon and Blitz participants building natively on Monad). The airdrop emphasizes rewarding authentic engagement over speculative behavior, reflecting a community-first philosophy akin to Bitcoin and Ethereum, positioning Monad as a high-performance, decentralized Layer-1 network built on real user participation.
